title: Probability of No Accepted Sample
statement: Let $N,k\in\mathbb{N}$ and put $L=\mathrm{size}(N-1)$, with subtraction truncated at zero. In the procedure that reads $k$ blocks of $L$ random bits and accepts a block when its value is less than $N$, the probability that no block is accepted is $\left(\frac{2^L-N}{2^L}\right)^k$.
